method.role_medians: unweighted medians of six independent trial metrics; not pooled request percentiles
method.paired_ci: copied/recomputed through frozen compareRuns, no new bootstrap implementation
method.cpu_ms_per_success: process CPU seconds *1000 / successful requests; includes synchronous and background work in snapshot window
method.average_cores: process CPU seconds / request measurement elapsed seconds; 1.0 means approximately one core continuously occupied, not a configured thread/core count
method.rss: sampled RSS peaks; service combined is sum of Go/Rust per-trial peaks, which need not occur simultaneously
method.p99: trial percentile from 1 ms histogram; table shows median of six such values
method.success: scenario-defined semantic success, including expected HTTP302 for miss guards
method.db_freshness: unique trial directories plus frozen harness creation contract; no independent database-content attestation
